text:
I couldn't open the WIRED roundup. The page was too large to load, so this is based on Macworld's review of the Satechi stand and its comparisons to other chargers.

**Best overall desk stand: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand (Qi2 25W), $129.99**
- **Charging:** It charges an iPhone at up to 25W (Qi2.2). The Apple Watch module and the AirPods pad each charge at 5W.
- **Stand:** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has seen. It lifts the phone over 70mm and tilts to 160°, which suits FaceTime calls and keeping the screen visible.
- **Power adapter:** It includes a 45W adapter with UK and EU plug adapters, plus a cable.
- **Travel:** It folds to 152 × 90 × 30mm, but it weighs 399g, which is more than twice the weight of the compact options below.
- **Buy:** [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GNRSY36V), [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/satechi-3-in-1-qi2-25w-fast-wireless-charging-stand-magnetic-foldable-for-iphone-apple-watch-airpods-space-black/J3GWC4C8TW) or [Satechi](https://satechi.com/products/3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-with-qi2-25w). The listed price is $129.99 at all of them.

**Best for travel (cheaper): ESR CryoBoost Foldable 3-in-1 (25W), $99.99**
- It's light (148g) and small (110 × 62 × 19.5mm), but it only raises the phone about 20mm.
- Buy it on [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FHQDKX7G).
- A third-party deal site, dealectric, lists a code, PARTNER18, that it says takes the price to about $82 at ESR's store. I didn't verify the code, so check it at checkout. The [deal page](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) is where it was listed.

**Most compact: Kuxiu X40 Turbo, $79.99**
- Macworld calls it "the one to beat" for compactness. It's 64 × 64 × 18.5mm and 148g, and it raises the phone about 35mm.
- Buy it from [Kuxiu](https://kuxiu.co/products/kuxiu-x40-turbo-stand).

**Other fast stands Macworld recommends** (I didn't fetch their reviews or prices):
- Belkin UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1
- Anker Prime 3-in-1 MagGo, which has a display
- Ugreen MagFlow Pro 3-in-1 25W, which has a cooling fan and was reviewed Oct 13, 2026

**My pick:** If the stand will mostly stay on a desk or nightstand, get the Satechi. If you'll travel with it often, the ESR or Kuxiu is the better fit. The 25W Qi2.2 speed only applies to newer iPhones that support it. Older MagSafe iPhones will charge more slowly.
